basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 25-year-old from Portland, Oregon, currently working as a barista but hoping to get into graphic design. I love exploring new hobbies, especially anything related to cannabis culture. I'm an avid reader of 'femboydiaries' and I’m curious about personal stories and experiences. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-11 PM. Currently single, and enjoying the freedom to focus on my interests and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My understanding of topics often comes from personal experiences and conversations with friends. I have no formal education in cannabis-related subjects but enjoy learning through community interactions. My knowledge about topics like COVID-19 long-haulers stems from news articles and online resources.
